summary: Hot Type's long GSAP-animated page for Exat, a 21-style neo-grotesk (Condensed, Normal, Wide) rooted in the Croatian EXAT 51 collective. Hard-edged poster tiles in orange, ultramarine, yellow, pink and green on off-white or charcoal. Rotating-letter grids, looping motion-design videos and a pointer-reactive letter field punctuate every chapter (About, Type tester, Character set, Design space, Stylistic sets, OpenType, Languages).
